content: Do you have any other hobbies besides stamp collecting?
Yes, fishing. I go fishing twice a week.
That's very popular too. Every time I passed the lake, I see many people sitting there with fishing rods in their hands, but I've never seen anyone catch anything.
Maybe it's because you lack patience.
Maybe you're right. I went fishing once, I sat till about 4 hours and got nothing. I broke my rod and decided not to fish anymore.
Oh, you didn't have to do that. Look at that man, there must be a huge fish on the end of the line. Let's go over and have a look.
OK. Wow, what a big fish.
So it is interesting to fish with a rod sitting at the lake. Safe, what do you often do in your spare time?
Oh, nothing special I read, watch TV and go to the movies.
Don't you have any hobbies like stamp collecting or things like that?
No, I don't have any hobbies.
